title: Exclude Type A rank-137 productive root splits (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** Under the exact #7113 caller and complete #7277 invoice, both Type A rank-137 roots fail to admit a positive two-factor split at any literal cut. The coordinate screen checks 9,568 root-boundary cases at both body-one phase signs. All 241 provisional interior cases fail the exact signed Laurent gate. The full original 72-field endpoint is verified.

Allowing an invertible q-even ordinary basis within a port requires a squarefree body mask and common central parity across all nonzero terms in the full root column. Independent forward and reverse replays match all 9,568 cases. There are 8,383 mixed body masks, 913 mixed phase parities and 272 zero-rank sides. Zero cases survive or remain unresolved.

The directed price retains all paid jobs and includes all 17 native copies. The optimistic compatible-stock upper across both roots is about 65.2479130965 raw units before added costs. The necessary support gate leaves zero compatible saving. The fixed #7277 comparison is κ = 0.003645669928698.

## Task and overlap

Rounds 54–55 of Discussion #7111, [checkpoint](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19551165). Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57, comparator #7277 at ed090b57ed88f8859e5ff4643645099e6ba856ea and caller #7113 at 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d. #7314 at 9d0119eb12fbd9fa534b48cd37b68e7099757b91 changes helper 863’s funded return and the paid route of role 1355. Here all paid caller operations stay fixed. #7243 examines older native chart cuts, #7313 charged native rank-six helpers, and #7315 Type B paid-idle grouping. The branch retains both published #7257 hosted-replay prerequisites with original authorship.

## Validation

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12 and assertions enabled:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-rank137-productive-root-bound
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-rank137-productive-root-bound --check-modes --check-source-history
```

Registered replay, source/byte/mode authentication, Git-free export replay and six navigation tests passed locally. The standalone replay regenerated all nine receipt hashes and rejected altered caller and body-one inputs. Hosted historical replay is pending at submission.
